settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure grouping parameters, naming rules, and appearance
settings.preview_max_mb_tooltip: Maximum preview size (MB) for individual images. Images exceeding this size will not generate previews. Set to 0 to disable previews. Currently only applies to common bitmap formats; RAW previews are not yet supported.
settings.sub_second_digits_tooltip: Number of sub-second digits displayed in capture time (0-9). Set to 0 to hide sub-seconds.
settings.aeb_max_span_tooltip: Maximum allowed time difference (seconds) between the first and last photo in an AEB group. Sequences exceeding this span will not be recognized as AEB groups. Recommended: 0.3-1.0 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.aeb_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos in an AEB group. Helps filter out duplicate records. Recommended: 0.01-0.1 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.aeb_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos in an AEB group. Recommended: 0.1-0.5 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.aeb_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required to form an AEB group. Typical AEB captures are 3, 5, or 7 shots.
settings.aeb_auto_bracket_tooltip: When enabled, only photos with EXIF ExposureMode set to 'Auto Bracket' (value: 2) will be recognized as AEB groups. Manual bracketing will not be recognized.
settings.focus_enabled_tooltip: Disable to stop recognizing focus bracket groups and avoid confusion with burst sequences. Enable only when focus bracketing is needed.
settings.focus_max_span_tooltip: Maximum allowed time difference (seconds) between the first and last photo in a focus bracket group. Recommended: 0.5-2.0 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.focus_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos. Recommended: 0.01-0.05 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.focus_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos. Recommended: 0.2-1.0 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.focus_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required to form a focus bracket group. Recommended: 3-7 photos.
settings.burst_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos in a burst group. Recommended: 0.01-0.05 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.burst_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval (seconds) between consecutive photos in a burst group. Recommended: 0.3-1.0 seconds. Set to -1 to disable this constraint.
settings.burst_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required to form a burst group. Usually at least 3 photos.
settings.focus_bracket_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for focus bracket groups. Organized photos will be placed in directories starting with this prefix.
settings.aeb_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for AEB groups.
settings.burst_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for burst groups.
settings.single_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for single photos. Leave empty to use original filenames without a prefix.
settings.plugin_hint: Place plugin ZIP files in the plugins/ directory under the application folder
